common.invitePh: Enter an invite code if you have one
common.ageConfirm: I am 14 or older. (Required; under 14 cannot sign up)

login.title: Welcome to AVIBE
login.subtitle: AI music streaming with verified commercial-use checks
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.registeredBody: Sign in, then open the verification link in your inbox. You can start listening right away, even before verifying.

social.sessionErr: Couldn't verify the social login session.

signup.title: Which account fits you?
signup.subtitle: You can add roles later in account settings.

listener.title: Listener sign-up
listener.subtitle: Start right away with just an email.
listener.name: Nickname / display name

creator.title: Creator sign-up
creator.profileNote: Extra profile details will be registered when Studio opens.
creator.success: Partner account registered. Please log in.

business.title: Business sign-up
business.foreignNote: Foreign businesses unlock after admin approval.
business.notice: Business Console is on the way. Your submission will be received as a sales inquiry, and a partner account will be registered first.
business.success: Your inquiry is received. Please log in.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We will send a reset link to your email.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, a reset link was sent. Check your inbox. (The link works once within 30 minutes.)

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter your new password.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.success: Password changed. Log in with the new password.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.noTokenBody: Open the verification link sent to the email you signed up with. Links stay valid for 24 hours.
verify.successBody: {email} is verified. You are signed in — enjoy the music.
verify.failedBody: The link expired or was already used. Sign in and request a new verification email.
verify.resent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verify.bannerText: Your email is not verified yet. Open the verification link in your inbox to unlock payments.

completeEmail.title: Enter your email
completeEmail.subtitle: Your social account did not share an email, so we need one more step.
completeEmail.pendingBody: We sent a verification email to {email}. Open the link in the mail to finish signing up.

oauth.processingBody: One moment. Please keep this window open.
oauth.invalidResponse: The social login response looks wrong. Please try again.
oauth.sessionFailed: Your social login session could not be verified.

ageGate.title: Confirm you're 14+
ageGate.desc: You signed in with a social account for the first time. AVIBE is 14+ only. Age confirmation is required for streaming, payments, and uploads.
